title: Thanaa
arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You; blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no deity besides You.

title: Du’a in Jalsa (I’tidal)
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shayṭān.

title: Tasmiyah (Bismillah)
translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

title: Tasbeeh in Rukuʿ
translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great.

title: Tasmeem / Dhikr after rising from Rukuʿ
translation: Allah hears him who praises Him.

title: Du’a in Qawmah (standing after Rukuʿ)
translation: O Allah, our Lord, unto You belongs all praise.

title: Tasbeeh in Sajdah
translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.

title: Du’a in Sajdah
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, grant me well‑being, guide me, and provide for me.

title: Tashahhud (Hanafi)
arabic: التحياتُ للهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
translation: All greetings, blessings, and good acts are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah’s mercy and blessings. Peace be upon us and on the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

title: Durood‑e‑Ibrahim
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى ابْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ ابْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى ابْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ ابْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Abraham and the family of Abraham; You are indeed praiseworthy, glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Abraham and the family of Abraham; You are indeed praiseworthy, glorious.

title: Du’a after Durood‑e‑Ibrahim
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا وَلا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
translation: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and no one forgives sins except You. So forgive me with forgiveness from Yourself, and have mercy on me. Indeed, You are the Oft‑Forgiving, Most Merciful.

title: Adhān
arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ…أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ…أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ…حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ…حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ…قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ…اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest… I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah… I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah… Hasten to prayer… Hasten to success… Prayer is ready to begin… Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no deity besides Allah.

title: Iqāmah
arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ…قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ…اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ

title: Du’a After Adhān
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، أَعِزَّ مُحَمَّدًا وَالْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدتَّهُ، إِنَّكَ لا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the prayer to be established, grant Muhammad the Wasilah and the Fadilah and raise him to the praised station You have promised; indeed You do not neglect Your promise.
